zh: 进行中那一行：皮肤把宿主自己的文字藏起来之后，画的替身又标着「装饰」，读屏在这一行上收不到「模型正在做什么」「暂未响应」和计时；现在替身是这一行的可读文字，宿主自己的实时区域照旧播报。
en: On the live turn's running row, the skin hid the host's own words and marked its replacement decorative, so a screen reader received neither what the model is doing, nor the wait badge, nor the clock; the replacement is the row's readable text now, and the host's own live region still announces the row.
